literature: Borggrefe et al 1997: 292-93 (photo); Raquet 2005b; Carter 2012: 314; Vereecke 2016: 110–11 (mouthpiece), 144–47, 197 (mouthpiece), 233–39.
remarks: Bell section only survives. Columnar stay in lower bow of secondary coil. Leaf-shaped saddle in primary bell-bow. Rectangular protrusions projecting inward and outward from upper coil of secondary bell-bow. The instrument was long thought to be missing its slide section, but in 2011 Hannes Vereecke, working with the staff of the museum, located the missing slide and the mouthpiece, and reassembled the instrument to its presumably original configuration.
